en: Extreme heat, deep crevasses: Zermatt closes the highest ski slopes in the Alps. Zermatt is closing its summer ski area. Those responsible say the situation is becoming too dangerous due to the lack of snow and deep crevasses. The end is also near in the second Valais summer ski area.
la: Extreme calor, profunda crevasses: Zermatt in Alpibus summa ski declivia claudit. Zermatt aream suam ski aestatis claudit. Qui responsales dicunt condicionem nimis periculosam esse propter inopiam nivis et concavitatis profundae. Finis etiam prope est in area secunda Valais aestate ski.
